records.title: Issues relating to industrial areas in Chandigarh
details: a to c: A Committee has been constituted by the Chandigarh Administration under the chairmanship of Deputy Commissioner-cum-Estate Officer on 23.01.2026 to revisit/amend Building Regulations to Reduce Land Loss in Industrial plots and it is being reviewed w.r.t. augmentation of services by Municipal Corporation towards increase in FAR.

records.title: Investigation Procedures in Air India Crash
details: a: Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) is conducting investigation as per the standards of International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO).

records.title: Installation of Rooftop Solar Plants
details: c to d: In addition, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been recently signed between MCC and Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. for setting up a segregated organic Municipal Solid Waste based Compressed Bio Gas plant at the Dadumajra dumping ground to process around 230 MTD of waste.

records.title: Projects by NHAI Chandigarh
details: Part (b) to (e); The stay has now been vacated by the Punjab & Haryana High Court. Considering the substantial gap of more than 5 years from the date of approval of project, a revised project report and cost estimate as per updated SOR is under preparation for approval.

records.title: Coversion Charges for Cooperative Societies in Chandigarh
details: Part (b): 18% GST on cernversion charges are levied by the Chandigarh Housing Board. However, clarification on the applicability of GST charges has been sought from Authority of Advance Ruling with the GST department by the Chandigarh Housing Board.
